Question 2
?
Consider the curve with parametric equations x=t3−2t,y=−2t+32,0≤t≤5. Fill in the blanks in the following table of values:
t 0 1 2 3 4 5
x 0 −1
4
 21 56
115
y 32 −12 −52
−92​
 −132 −172
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

  • To find the value of x(2), we substitute t=2 into x=t3−2t. This gives x(2)=(2)3−2(2)=8−4=4.

  • To find the value of y(3), we substitute t=3 into y=−2t+32. This gives y(3)=−2(3)+32=−6+32=−122+32=−92.

  • To find the value of x(5), we substitute t=5 into x=t3−2t. This gives x(5)=(5)3−2(5)=125−10=115.

Then the table is

t 0 1 2 3 4 5
x 0 −1 4 21 56 115
y 32 −12 −52 −92 −132 −172
